scripts.docker:build: docker build --build-arg GIT_COMMIT_HASH="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --build-arg GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE="$(git log -1 --format=%s)" --build-arg GIT_COMMIT_AUTHOR="$(git log -1 --format=%an)" --build-arg GIT_COMMIT_DATE="$(git log -1 --format=%cI)" -t iusta-connector .
scripts.docker:run: docker rm -f iusta-connector >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --rm --name iusta-connector -e ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 -p 3000:3000 iusta-connector
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.client:verify: bun run client:build && bun run scripts/verify-client.ts
